Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 11/2 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03."

Your own recap note from Dec 8, 2025 gives the same official date. It adds that you kept running the account day to day until the terminal cutover finished. Kwame fully took over operationally on **November 22, 2025**.

For the coverage tracker, I'd use 11/3 as the official change date. You could add 11/22 as the date Kwame took over day-to-day, if the tracker has a field for it.
